answer: Three peers drawn at random from a pool that excludes any wallet sharing funding with the submitter re-execute the claimed work on their own state and publish a signed delta between claimed and actual output, so a fabricated fable shows as a nonzero number next block instead of an opinion, and the difference is charged to the identity that filed it. The cost sits upstream. An attacker who seeds 200 recruits through one pulse of funding loses the cluster the first time any recruit misbehaves, since the evidence links back to the sable mark on the original deposit.
